links.outcome: Generation quality (ROUGE-1-f, BERTScore_F1) with retrieval grounding vs direct prompting
links.effect: Dialogue-based retrieval significantly improved generation quality relative to direct prompting (ROUGE-1-f: +12.6%, BERTScore_F1: +1.5%, p < 0.05).
links.quote: Experimental results show that dialogue-based retrieval significantly improves generation quality relative to direct prompting (e.g., ROUGE-1-f: +12.6%, BERTScore_F1: +1.5%, p < 0.05).

unlisted_practices: Comparing retrieval pipelines (dense retrieval, Cross-Encoder reranking, RRF, cascade) for RAG accuracy-latency trade-offs

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) with doctor-patient dialogue sources
screen.reason: Evaluates adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding and specific reranking configurations to baseline LLMs for clinical question answering.
